choices.reason: The paper prespecifies a suite of correlated diversity measures; MiniLM is highlighted for exploratory trajectory plots, while neither the abstract/introduction nor the preregistered final-story analysis singles out one candidate. None has statistics sufficient for a participant-level standardized effect, and the remaining rules cannot resolve the metric tie; the linked OSF registration could not be accessed.

choices.quote: Our view is that diversity in natural language is a latent construct; instead of taking a particular view of diversity, we pre-specify a suite of diversity metrics, each providing correlated aspects of text diversity, see Table 3.
